title: Primakov proposes that the SVR keep Arafat alive and the CIA keep Rabin alive

tellings.quote: >> "Our goal will be to keep Arafat alive. Your goal will be to keep Rabin alive."

plain: In Moscow in 1993, Yevgeny Primakov, then head of the SVR, Russia's foreign intelligence service, is said to have offered the CIA a deal: "Our goal will be to keep Arafat alive. Your goal will be to keep Rabin alive." Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former CIA officer, tells Michels this as something Primakov said to him, an offer that would have had rival spy services each guarding a different side's leader in the Middle East peace process.
